items.where: PDF link audit; weeks, w27, u182, u354
items.note: Weeks run in order: week next/prev chain verified w01..w52, day chain verified over all 364 days including week edges; prev/next buttons 36x32 pt; trail on all 416 week/day pages.

Photos 1-8 show the built pages, each captioned with its page name (Cover, Day page, Week page, Month page, Start here, Setup check, Contents, Year at a glance, Habit tracker). The description gives the counts and says undated, Monday start, portrait only, English only, not a fillable form, no stickers.
Three jump buttons (month, year, Contents) and a four-line Nothing happened? list. In the PDF all 9,867 links resolve to real pages and all 453 pages can be reached from the cover.

The FAQ answers the five problems the brief names (Etsy app, which app, links with the pen on, typing, undated weeks). Help says to use the Setup check and then send an Etsy message, with no reply-time promise (r007 ok).
Day, week and month pages are shown close up and readable in photos 2, 3 and 4. The listing says there are no budget, meal or fitness sections.

Half the day page is time blocks plus Good things, and each weekday has its own lined box on the week page (3 lines each). Photo 2 is a readable close-up, but at about 1x the on-iPad scale, not the 'twice' in the brief. The 1.1 text scale cannot be checked.
Weeks page lists Week 1-52, each with a 'starts ____' line and a 120x46pt link; Start here: 'Open Week 1, write this Monday's date, then open today's page'; month grids are 6 rows x 7 (42 boxes).
Pages are a 3:4 portrait shape. The week page has two columns (Mon to Thu on the left; Fri, Sat, Sun and dotted Notes on the right), with This week's top 3 and Next week underneath.
Has jump buttons to a month page, the year and Contents (each 242x41 pt), a full-height pen test box, a 4-line fix list and a top-bar map. The map's Weeks row has no description (see visual).
6am to 9pm hourly rows sit beside Top 3 and To do on every day screenshot.

Background is #FBF9F4 and headings are #1E2238 ink, with indigo-to-gold tabs. Cormorant is used for headings and italic labels, Manrope for body text. There are no tracked all-caps labels. Body text is a softer #555A6E, still about 6.5:1 contrast.

visual.issue: In the Setup check's 'Where things are: the top bar' map, the Weeks row is blank: every other row has a description and Weeks has none, so it looks unfinished. The other descriptions reuse section taglines ('Calendar', 'Keep it all in one place', 'Write anything') rather than saying what the button opens.

On the week pages, each day opens its day page only through a 224x20 pt strip on the day-name header. Nothing marks it as tappable (no arrow or button style), and 20 pt is about 29 pt on an 11-inch iPad, below the 44 pt touch minimum. Neither Start here nor How the links work says that tapping a day name opens the day, so buyers may think the week-to-day link is missing.

Photo 8 shows two small landscape crops in the top two-thirds and leaves the bottom third empty. At Etsy zoom the year-overview month names, weekday letters and the habit tracker's day numbers are tiny (r013).
Photo 4's headline 'Months that always fit' is about the 6-row grid, but the crop shows only 3 rows, so the photo does not show the claim it makes.
Photo 3's week crop fills only the middle band, with about 25% empty background above and below; the page could be shown larger.
Photo 2's point 'Notes box under your list' is backed only by the Notes label at the cut edge; the box itself is out of frame. The alt text is honest ('the start of Notes').

Several key buttons are small: the Start here 'Go there' buttons are 76x25 pt (one is the day-one path to Week 1), the month page's Habit tracker and All weeks buttons are 23 pt tall, the Setup check map rows are 23-24 pt, and Open planner is 28 pt. On an iPad that is about 33 to 40 pt, below 44.
The month page's two buttons use different styles: 'Habit tracker' is outlined Cormorant italic and 'All weeks' is a filled Manrope bold pill.
The listing's top-bar list ('Home, Year, Notes and Weeks') leaves out Lists, which is on every top bar in the file (r003).
The listing says 'Any-Monday.pdf (12.2 MB)', but the file is 12,886,545 bytes (12.9 MB, or 12.3 MiB) (r003).
Start here step 1 gives only Share > Open in Goodnotes. It leaves out the Goodnotes New > Import path that the listing and photo 9 give.
Some boxes are partly empty: the bottom third of the Start here step 1 and step 4 cards, and the bottom third of the week page's 'This week's top 3' box (r006).
On the week page, each day's date slot is two tiny pale dashes ('_ _') in the box corner, which is easy to miss even though the page is titled 'Write the dates'.

Day one, early buyer (r002/r014): someone who starts in late October runs 52 weeks into the next October, so the starting month's page has to cover both years. Neither Start here nor the listing says how to handle this.
